title: Indian Railways Standard General Conditions of Contract (GCC) April 2022 — IREPS digitally signed copy with scanned circular prefix
issuer: Indian Railways (Railway Board), Ministry of Railways, Government of India; published via IREPS (CRIS)

extraction_settings.download_command: curl -L --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 300 --retry 2 --retry-delay 5 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" -H "Accept: application/pdf,*/*" -o original.pdf "<URL>"
extraction_settings.raw_ocr_command: pdftotext original.pdf -   # verbatim output, written unmodified to raw_ocr.txt (poppler 26.01.0)
extraction_settings.pages_json_command: pdftotext -f N -l N original.pdf -   # per page N=1..page_count, one-based page_no, assembled in order
extraction_settings.normalization_rules: R1 remove NUL bytes; R2 CRLF and lone CR to LF; R3 U+00A0 and U+2007..U+200B converted to U+0020; R4 ligatures U+FB00-FB06 expanded to component letters; R5 form-feed (U+000C) page markers removed; R6 trailing whitespace stripped per line; R7 runs of 3+ blank lines collapsed to 2; R8 nothing else — no spelling, hyphenation or OCR repair of any kind
extraction_settings.verification_commands: file --mime-type original.pdf; sha256sum original.pdf; head -c 8 (PDF magic check)

characteristics.notes: scanned circular prefix (p2-3) with noisy OCR text layer; header stamps alternate between 'GCC April 2022' (typed body) and 'GCC July 2020' (index pages); version pair with failed SRC-08 (ACS-9) and SRC-09 (ACS-11)

document_version_identity: GCC April 2022 (IREPS digital signature by DAVULURI SREE VENKATESH, 23.09.2024, IREPS-CRIS); circular prefix No. 2022/CE-I/CT(AC)/GCC-2022/Policy dated 27.04.2022; index pages carry 'GCC July 2020' base stamps under the April 2022 edition
ambiguous_boundaries: typed GCC body vs scanned circular prefix: pages 2-3 are an OCR-noisy scanned circular (garbled Devanagari), page 1 is a typed cover, page 4 begins the typed INDEX — single contract, no sub-boundaries drawn
attribution_string: Source: Indian Railways (Railway Board), Ministry of Railways, Government of India; published via IREPS (CRIS), <https://www.ireps.gov.in/ireps/upload/files/092024/77357644/GCC-APRIL-2022.pdf>, accessed 2026-10-28; reproduced under the Ministry of Railways copyright policy <https://indianrailways.gov.in/footer/copyright-policy>.
